story_overview: In a high-tech world of meta-humans, Marcus struggles with a recent trauma inside a containment cell, supported by his friend Leo. Meanwhile, Julian, Chloe, and the rest of their team operate from a command center, investigating threats that escalate from a mysterious energy attack in a government plaza to a tense confrontation in an abandoned warehouse.
